user.title: Set up Anti-Cycling Climate
user.description: Choose the climate entity and room temperature sensor that should be controlled together.

data_description.climate_entity: The climate entity whose heat, cool, or dry modes should use Anti-Cycling.
data_description.sensor_entity: The separate sensor measuring actual room temperature. It must provide a numeric temperature state.

settings.title: Temperature and hysteresis settings
settings.description: The target slider limits are automatically taken from the climate device's supported min_temp and max_temp values.

data.heat_offset: Offset in the normal hysteresis range

data_description.warm_margin: How far room temperature must exceed the target before Anti-Cycling lowers the heating setpoint. Default: 1.2 °C.
data_description.cooling_setback: The heating setpoint used when the room is too warm. Must be within the climate device's allowed range. Default: 17 °C, clamped to the device limits when needed.
data_description.heat_offset: Offset below the current climate temperature while within the normal hysteresis range. Default: 2 °C.

error.unsupported_climate: The climate entity must expose current_temperature, temperature, and hvac_modes, and support at least one of heat, cool, or dry.
error.missing_temperature_limits: The climate entity does not provide valid min_temp and max_temp limits, so safe temperature bounds cannot be configured.
error.setback_out_of_range: The setback temperature must be within the climate device's allowed limits.

abort.already_configured: This climate and temperature sensor combination is already configured.

init.title: Anti-Cycling settings
init.description: The setback temperature must remain within the climate device's supported temperature limits.

data.heat_offset: Offset in the normal hysteresis range

data_description.warm_margin: Temperature above the room target that activates over-temperature handling. Default: 1.2 °C.
data_description.cooling_setback: Heating setpoint used when the room is too warm. The climate device's allowed range is enforced. Default: 17 °C.
data_description.heat_offset: Offset below the current climate temperature in the normal hysteresis range. Default: 2 °C.

error.setback_out_of_range: The setback temperature must be within the device limits.
